# Audiment – Product Overview & Knowledge Guide

## What is Audiment?
Audiment is multi-location audit and inspection management software. It enables operations directors, quality teams, and area managers to run proof-based audits across distributed branch networks (restaurants, QSRs, retail stores, hotels, healthcare facilities, and manufacturing sites), eliminate fake audits through live photo verification and GPS geofencing, and automatically track corrective actions (CAPA) to resolution with photo proof.

## Core Platform Capabilities
- **Proof-Based Auditing:** Audit checklist questions can require live in-app photos. Gallery uploads can be blocked by default to prevent outdated or fraudulent photo reuse.
- **Auditor Presence Verification:** GPS geofencing and on-site verification confirm the auditor is physically at the designated location before audit submission.
- **Automated Corrective Actions (CAPA):** Failed inspection items automatically generate corrective action tasks assigned to branch managers with severity-based SLA deadlines. Tasks require photo proof of resolution before being closed.
- **Multi-Location & Regional Dashboards:** Operations directors can benchmark scores across locations, regions, and timeframes to detect operational drift and systemic recurring failures.
- **FSSAI & Regulatory Templates:** Pre-configured inspection checklists for food safety (FSSAI), hygiene, brand standards, and operational compliance.
- **Offline Fieldwork Capability:** Auditors can conduct audits without an active internet connection; data and media sync automatically once connectivity is restored.

## Target Audience & Industry Solutions
Audiment is built for multi-location enterprises managing 5 to 500+ locations:
- Restaurant chains and QSRs: Food safety, kitchen hygiene, brand consistency, opening/closing checklists.
- Retail store networks: Visual merchandising, store standards, inventory checks, loss prevention.
- Hotel & hospitality groups: Room inspections, guest area standards, facility safety.
- Franchise networks: Brand compliance, franchisee standard operational adherence.
- Healthcare & clinical facilities: Operational hygiene, regulatory documentation, safety compliance.
- Manufacturing: Layered process audits, 5S workplace safety, quality assurance.

## Commercial Comparisons & Alternative Evaluations
- Audiment vs SafetyCulture (iAuditor): https://audiment.in/compare/audiment-vs-safetyculture
  * Summary: SafetyCulture focuses on heavy industrial/EHS safety with per-seat licensing. Audiment specializes in multi-location food, retail, and franchise networks with mandatory live-camera verification, GPS presence checks, automated CAPA SLA escalation, and flat per-location pricing with unlimited users.
- Audiment vs GoAudits: https://audiment.in/compare/audiment-vs-goaudits
  * Summary: GoAudits functions as an entry-level checklist tool for generating PDF reports. Audiment is an operational accountability system enforcing live photo evidence, geofenced auditor presence, automated multi-tier corrective action escalation, and regional drift analytics.
- Audiment vs Zenput (Crunchtime): https://audiment.in/compare/audiment-vs-zenput
  * Summary: Zenput is tied into the broader Crunchtime back-office restaurant ERP suite with lengthy enterprise implementations. Audiment delivers an agile standalone audit execution platform with rapid 1-2 week deployment, out-of-the-box FSSAI compliance, and predictable per-location billing.
- Audiment vs Jolt: https://audiment.in/compare/audiment-vs-jolt
  * Summary: Jolt relies heavily on mounted kitchen tablets, Bluetooth probes, and proprietary date label printers. Audiment is 100% BYOD on employee smartphones with zero hardware investment, combined with macro multi-store comparative rollups.
- Audiment vs Generic Checklist Apps: https://audiment.in/compare/audiment-vs-checklist-apps
  * Summary: Generic forms (Google Forms, Excel) enable unverified "pencil-whipping" and lack follow-through. Audiment enforces proof-based checks (live camera, GPS geofencing) and automatically routes audit failures into SLA-tracked corrective action tasks.
